If $\Delta f=R$, then for every smooth bounded domain $\Omega $, \[ \int _\Omega \left( rac{| abla R+R abla f|^2}{R} +2\left| abla ^2f- frac 12(\Delta f)g ight|^2 ight)d\mu \le \int _{\partial \Omega } u (R+| abla f|^2)d\sigma . \] This follows from Bochner's identity and Hamilton's trace Harnack estimate.
